messages:
Maria Gonzales: quick sync we need a concrete roadmap for routing policies + multi-region isolation. goal: gates, pilot plan, infra deps. suggestions?
Alex Choi: propose three lanes: latency-critical, cost-optimized, geo-restricted. each lane gets SLOs, cache isolation switch, and billing tags. map customers to lanes to reduce scope.
Samir Kaur: add a resilient fallback lane that preserves legal posture but uses lower-capacity model variants when overloaded. keeps apps online.
Jen Li: PM needs launch gates to tell sales: Gate A = policy primitives + feature flag, Gate B = telemetry + per-tenant metrics + canary (<10 tenants), Gate C = SLO validation + runbook + comms.
Maria Gonzales: agree. acceptance tests: per-tenant prompt set (50-100), quality regression <2%, cost delta <10%.
Alex Choi: numeric SLOs: latency-critical p95 <120ms (short prompts), resilient p95 <250ms, cost-optimized p95 <350ms with -40% token cost target. geo-restricted requires KMS and audit logs.
Samir Kaur: sample canary config: route_policy: latency-critical; weight: 0.1; fallback: variant-q4-compat. automate via console rollout APIs.
deploy-bot: canary start: routing-service v5.0 -> infra/canary (8 tenants). CI: passed. smoke: warning in eu-west-2 tail latency.
Alex Choi: hold eu-west-2 canary until IO tail fix. add region quick-stop in rollback playbook.
Jen Li: migration path for customers: 6-week opt-in pilot, 4-week migration window, 2-week monitored ramp. opt-out must be automated. sales requests SLA credit language for regressions.
Maria Gonzales: action items: infra list deps + minimal telemetry events; PM to prepare customer comms; engineering to own perf budgets. publish README + launch checklist before canaries.
Alex Choi: :thumbsup:
Samir Kaur: :thumbsup:
Jen Li: :thumbsup:
